t: Where To Buy Real Japanese Knives In Kyoto 2025 Guide | Where and Wander
s: March 19, 2025 - Shigeharu (location) The oldest knife shop in Kyoto dating back 800 years. The selection of blades here are hand-forged by the owner and worth the effort of having to track down their irregular opening hours. It’s more or less a one man shop, so don’t expect a waiting staff to answer basic questions. I’d come here more or less knowing what you want to buy and seeing if there is something that matches that.
